tasks.label: CareerVerse Web Push worker
tasks.command: Set-Location .\CareerVerseAppWeb\backend; . .\local-settings.ps1; while ($true) { & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py send_push_notifications --limit 100; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Push delivery worker failed' }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30 }

tasks.label: CareerVerse Stripe test webhook
tasks.command: $stripe = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA Microsoft\WinGet\Links\stripe.exe; & $stripe listen --events checkout.session.completed,checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded --forward-to http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/billing/webhook/ 2>&1 | ForEach-Object { ([string]$_) -replace 'whsec_[A-Za-z0-9]+', '[hidden signing secret]' }
